get.summary: Lists every configured api client. Secrets are never returned.

put.summary: Updates an api client. Secrets are overwritten only when a new value is sent.

get.summary: Gets added crawl links, the results are paginated.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of elements to return.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Optional search term applied server-side on title and provider.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional status filter: all, in-progress, downloaded, error.

post.summary:
Extracts media information from a URL without persisting anything. If the URL points to a show
page with multiple seasons, the response indicates that season selection is required — call the
select-season endpoint with the chosen season. Otherwise the response carries an addToken; pass
it to confirm-add to commit the link.

requestBody.description: The object containing the mandatory data for link extraction.

400.description: Provider not supported or extraction failed

409.description: A link for this URL is already added

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the crawl link to delete.

404.description: No crawl link found for the given id

post.summary:
Selects a season for a show page URL and previews the crawl link (without persisting). Call this
when the initial extraction returned requiresSeasonSelection = true.

requestBody.description: The request containing URL, selected season, and user info.

200.description: Preview returned with an add token (check mediaExistsOnServer for duplicates)

409.description: A link for this URL is already added

post.summary:
Commits a previously-previewed crawl link to the database. Call after add or select-season,
passing the addToken from that response.

requestBody.description: The request containing the add token and an optional title.

409.description: A link for this URL is already added

410.description: The preview expired or the token was already used — add the link again

put.summary: Changes the name of the show for an added link.

parameters.name: crawlLinkId
parameters.description: The id of the crawl link to rename.

requestBody.description: The objects containing the new name.

404.description: No crawl link found for the given id

parameters.name: crawlLinkId
parameters.description: The id of the crawl link to update.

get.summary: Downloads the debrided file from a specified file host and URL.

parameters.name: fileHost
parameters.description: The name of the file hosting service.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL of the file to be debrided.

200.description: An IActionResult containing the stream of the downloaded file.

get.summary: Gets all running or queued downloads

delete.summary: Cancels a download by its file url

get.summary: Gets the list of Live TV channels.
Gets the list of enabled providers.

parameters.name: searchEnabled
parameters.description: Indicates if it should return only providers which have the search functionality.

get.summary: Gets every provider regardless of enabled state (management view).
Gets the available search filters for a given provider and a media category

200.description: The list of available filters for the provided media category

post.summary: Search the provider website and gets the results. The results are paginated.

parameters.name: providerId
parameters.description: The provider id on which to perform the search

200.description: Page of the provider's search results.

get.summary: Gets the Live TV channel source (DB value, or config fallback when never saved).

put.summary: Updates the Live TV channel source. Applies from the next LiveTvChannelsJob run.

get.summary: Gets the list of countries the current Live TV source exposes (empty if it can't be reached).

fromDatabase.description: False when the values come from the config-file fallback (nothing saved yet).
